responsibility: This header declares the array-lowering and scalarization interface used by the Fortran GENERIC translation phase. It exposes routines for array allocation, descriptor construction and access, temporary creation, scalarization walks and loop setup, dependency resolution, array argument conversion, descriptor/CFI helpers, constant array-constructor translation, string copying, and related allocatable/component support shared across trans-* files.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public array-lowering and scalarization interface—descriptor helpers, temporary/allocation routines, expression walkers, loop utilities, and CFI accessors—for use by other trans-* files. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans-array.cc, it does not implement those array translation algorithms.
